evidence.venue: archived public GitHub repository reconstructed from an early Manus sandbox
evidence.implementation_policy: mechanism was studied; Tier Bench implementation is independently authored and does not vendor the recovered files

components.transfer: one durable browser context per task computer with state hashes, file artifacts, and recovery receipts

components.role: in-page compiler that identifies visible interactive elements, assigns numeric indexes, traverses frames and open shadow roots, and paints overlays
components.transfer: independently authored DOM probe producing indexed semantic elements and a marked screenshot

components.role: executes the DOM compiler through Playwright and reconstructs the model-facing element tree and selector map
components.transfer: browser state is a compiled artifact rather than raw HTML or coordinates

components.role: serializes interactive elements into compact indexed text such as [index]<tag>name

components.transfer: Tier Bench stores stable element signatures and binds every action to an exact state hash

components.transfer: strict action schema, stale-state rejection, approval classification, and append-only action receipts

components.role: planner protocol with page summary, previous-goal evaluation, memory, next goal, and up to ten actions
components.transfer: planner and browser executor communicate through typed state and action documents

components.role: observe, plan, act, record, retry, pause, and stop loop with optional separate planner and extraction models
components.transfer: desktop control plane may route observation to one model and actions to another without moving the browser session

components.role: FastAPI browser, terminal, text-editor, upload, and download surface inside one sandbox computer
components.transfer: authenticated local browser service, event stream, artifacts, health, action, takeover, and shutdown endpoints

components.role: per-action browser health, controller execution, state refresh, clean and marked screenshots, scroll metrics, and restart
components.transfer: every action returns a new state and evidence packet rather than a bare success string

components.role: browser action and result types spanning semantic indexes, coordinates, screenshots, console actions, and page state
components.transfer: semantic actions are primary; coordinates and arbitrary JavaScript are privileged fallbacks

mechanism: Playwright controls one Chromium context that belongs to a task computer.
An injected DOM compiler converts the rendered page into visible text, numbered interactive elements, and a marked screenshot.
A planner evaluates the previous step and emits typed actions against the numbered state.
The controller executes actions through Playwright and refreshes state after each change.
A multi-action batch is interrupted when navigation, tabs, or interactive topology changes.
Downloads, screenshots, extracted text, cookies, and traces become files in the same computer workspace.
Browser health and page death are explicit runtime states rather than conversational errors.
